gpt_image_2.hint: State subject, composition, exact text/layout, materials, lighting, camera, and what must remain unchanged.

gpt4o_gpt_image_1.strong_at: conceptual image generation, styles, visual examples
gpt4o_gpt_image_1.hint: Describe the full scene and desired visual intent; preserve source attribution when adapting examples.

midjourney.structure: concise visual phrase + style + composition + parameters
midjourney.hint: Use concise visual descriptors; add aspect ratio and stylization parameters only when relevant.

flux.hint: Prioritize clear subject, spatial relationships, materials, lighting and camera language.

nano_banana.structure: scene + subject + environment + light + camera/lens + edit constraints
nano_banana.hint: Be explicit about what changes and what stays fixed; specify angle, lens and lighting.

seedream.hint: Specify layout hierarchy, key text, brand mood, subject and visual style.

stable_diffusion.structure: positive prompt + optional negative prompt + model/sampler context
stable_diffusion.hint: Keep positive and negative concepts separable and preserve model-specific parameters outside the semantic prompt.

ideogram.structure: subject + composition + explicit typography/text + design style
ideogram.hint: Quote exact text, state placement/hierarchy, then describe design style, subject and composition.

seedance.structure: shot sequence + subject action + camera movement + timing/transitions
seedance.strong_at: cinematic sequence, ads, UGC, multi-shot motion
seedance.hint: Write the temporal sequence explicitly and separate subject motion from camera motion.

veo.structure: shot + camera + action + environment + cinematic treatment + audio if needed
veo.strong_at: cinematic scene direction and audiovisual prompting
veo.hint: Define shot type, camera behavior, action, environment and optional dialogue/audio.

kling.structure: start state + action/physics + camera + end state
kling.hint: Describe motion mechanics and end state clearly; avoid conflicting movement instructions.

runway.structure: subject motion + camera motion + scene motion
runway.hint: If an input image already defines appearance, spend text budget on motion and camera behavior.

sora.structure: scene progression + action + camera + cinematic detail
sora.strong_at: coherent scene development and cinematic direction
sora.hint: Describe how the scene evolves over time, not just a static frame.

hailuo.hint: Use explicit action verbs, camera movement and motion intensity.

wan.structure: subject + action + camera + scene + temporal transition
wan.hint: Keep motion, scene and camera instructions distinct.

luma.hint: Describe the camera path and one dominant subject motion.

pika.hint: Keep the central transformation/effect explicit and concise.

qwen_image_3.structure: deliverable/use-case + goal + scene/subject + style + composition + exact text/data + constraints
qwen_image_3.strong_at: text-heavy layouts, multilingual typography, e-commerce, infographics, consistent series
qwen_image_3.hint: Define the deliverable first, quote exact on-image copy, state hierarchy and constraints, and separate facts from visual style.

z_image.structure: subject + visual style + composition + lighting + material/camera
z_image.strong_at: fast image generation and editing workflows
z_image.hint: Keep subject and composition explicit; use precise material, lighting and edit-preservation language.

ltx_video.structure: shot/scene + subject action + camera movement + temporal beats + dialogue/audio + settings
ltx_video.strong_at: reproducible video prompts, camera movement, product video, dialogue and synchronized audio
ltx_video.hint: Describe one temporal sequence at a time, keep camera motion separate from subject motion, and preserve generation settings/provenance.

cogvideox.structure: scene + action + temporal progression + camera + style
cogvideox.strong_at: open video workflows and prompt-engineered text-to-video
cogvideox.hint: Use concrete action verbs, temporal ordering and camera direction; avoid static image-only wording.

hunyuan_video.structure: scene + subject motion + camera + style + temporal consistency
hunyuan_video.strong_at: open video generation and stylized motion workflows
hunyuan_video.hint: Specify continuous motion, camera behavior and visual style without contradictory actions.

higgsfield.structure: creative intent + shot design + camera/motion control + character consistency + temporal beat + edit/extend constraints
higgsfield.strong_at: cinematic ads, camera moves, character consistency, Seedance/Kling workflows
higgsfield.hint: State the cinematic objective first, then camera/motion behavior, identity consistency, timing, and edit/extend constraints. Avoid mixing incompatible camera moves.

mochi_video.structure: scene + action + camera + visual mood + duration-aware progression
mochi_video.hint: Favor a coherent single scene with explicit action and camera movement.
